exact_items: project_summary.v1:{project_id} must be a dedicated redb projection key, not mixed into projects:v1
projects:v1 must remain a narrow registry only (id, name, created_at, archived_at, optional display hints)
project_summary must carry: project health, active run count, last run identity, concern counts by severity, blocked status, last-activity timestamp
notes: projects:v1 narrowing prevents dashboard loading from pulling full project detail prematurely

exact_items: project_attention_item.v1:{project_id}:{attention_item_id} must be a dedicated redb projection key
project_attention_item family is absent from storage-plan.md

projection must carry canonical shape defined in the attention center cluster analysis: attention_item_id, project_id, severity, owner_kind, reason_code, source_kind, source_object_ref, primary_route_payload, secondary_route_payloads[], display_title, display_subtitle, disclosure_visibility
project_state:v1:{project_id} must stay narrow as a UI state container
must not expand to hold runtime summary, concern counts, or health — these belong to project_summary
project_state must carry only: selected tab, focus state, open panels, UI-transient settings that should not survive sessions
A canonical internal route payload schema must be defined in one doc (Contracts_V0.md or FinalGUISpec.md)
Minimum required fields for all route payloads: surface_id, object_kind, object_id (or object_ref), project_id?
Optional fields depending on surface: run_id, attempt_id, node_id, concern_id, attention_item_id, focus_sub_tab, lane_id, worktree_id
route payload is used by: deep links, palette actions, cmd.*.open_in_* commands, attention item primary_route_payload, and resume_url serialization
resume_url is the transport/serialized form of a canonical route payload, not a separate identity system
resume_url must be derivable from any canonical route payload via a deterministic serialization rule
No doc currently defines this derivation or mandates that resume URLs and canonical route payloads are interchangeable for navigation purposes
Retire generic page: string route payload field — it is too coarse for cross-surface navigation and deep-link targeting
Replace all occurrences of bare page: string with the canonical route payload schema (surface_id + object_kind + object_id)
Any existing uses of page: string in cmd.* args or attention item payloads must be migrated
trust / permission decisions cluster: Permissions_System.md session cache and reject-cascade must be re-scoped to actor/lane-aware boundaries
Permission snapshot invalidation on account switch must be defined: when account changes, which cached permission decisions are stale
Always-approval and never-approval decisions must be scoped to (actor_kind, tool, scope_context) not to (session-global, tool)
Multi-actor permission snapshot isolation must be normative and testable
notes: Session-global always/never approvals under multi-lane/multi-actor creates permission contamination risk — this is a correctness issue, not just style

exact_items: A2A stream schema tier_boundary replacement must be versioned: introduce governance_boundary in stream version N+1, provide migration adapter from version N
attempt_id must be declared as a required field in the governance_boundary diagnostic category
A compatibility alias tier_boundary -> governance_boundary must be explicitly time-boxed in Architecture_Invariants.md
Overseer audit protocol in A2A doc must be superseded: rewrite §9 to describe the dual-overseer / corroboration model, remove singular-Overseer language, add minority_advisory outcome category
§9 rewrite must reference the canonical corroboration record family, overseer quorum rules, and audit receipt shape
receipt records (orchestrator.receipt.{run_id}.{attempt_id}) must carry project_id and created_at_utc as required fields to enable cross-surface pivoting
The early storage-plan receipt value shape that omits these fields must be updated to match the later cross-surface record definition
This is an internal contradiction within storage-plan.md — the later definition must win
usage_event_ref schema must be defined once as a structured locator object
Minimum fields: project_id, run_id, attempt_id?, node_id, lane_id?, created_at_utc
All surface pivots (Show in Usage, Show in Ledger, pivot from receipt) must use this structured locator — not a bare opaque string ID
usage_event_id as bare opaque ID must be retired in favor of usage_event_ref
The canonical actor envelope (project_id + actor_kind + sparse actor refs + requested/effective identity block) must be anchored in Contracts_V0.md
All runtime records, receipts, usage events, stream events, concern records, and attention items must reference the canonical actor envelope by name rather than redeclaring fields ad-hoc
actor_kind and execution_role enums must be defined in the same anchoring section
do-not-forget: selected_repo_id already exists in storage planning; gap is now in UI contract adoption
GitHub_Integration.md must adopt selected_repo_id from storage-plan.md rather than treating it as a future undefined key
Deferred GitHub Recovery Binding must be wired to the canonical blocked-episode / concern record path, not to a UI-local heuristic
